deadline.intake: 2026/27 early enrolment phase; same phase deadlines for EU and non-EU (passed)

tuition.note: no annual non-EU bachelor figure found; first instalment EUR 880.04, second EUR 0-3,003 by ECTS/ISEE

requirement.text: Non-EU applicants abroad need a secondary qualification after 12-13 years of schooling (or foundation year), must pass the TOL/CEnT-S/SAT-based admission test (min 30/100), prove programme language level, and obtain a study visa via Universitaly.
